chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) regarding the sending of the Messengers, the virtue of the People of the House, and the mention of the people of misguidance.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What are the main themes of Imam Ali's sermon on the Prophets and the Ahl al-Bayt in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This sermon, often cited in Shia theological discourse, establishes the continuity of divine guidance through the Prophets while elevating the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate custodians of this legacy. Imam Ali (AS) contrasts the clarity of the guided path with the confusion of the misguided, framing the Ahl al-Bayt as the anchor of orthodoxy against sectarian deviation. The text serves as a foundational argument for the spiritual authority of the Imams within the broader narrative of Islamic history.
